articles.title: Kayrros sale signals rising demand for satellite intelligence amid Hormuz crisis
articles.summary:
Tensions around the Strait of Hormuz have pushed interest in commercial geospatial intelligence services to unprecedented levels, an executive at Kayrros said after the satellite analytics provider agreed to be acquired by Energy Aspects.
The post Kayrros sale signals rising demand for satellite intelligence amid Hormuz crisis appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: To Protect Artemis II Astronauts, NASA Experts Keep Eyes on Sun
